title: google_sheets_append.input
description: Input for the Google Sheets append tool. WRITE-category: approval required. Permissive-by-design (D-05); spreadsheet_id is the cost/security-critical target and is validated.

range.description: A1 range / sheet name to append after (e.g. 'Sheet1!A1').

values.description: Rows to append; each row is an array of cell values.
